sessionHistory.note: bd sync was blocked by the approval reviewer because the configured beads sync remote is an external git+ssh destination; I did not retry or work around it. The sandboxed npm test run failed with EPERM on child processes/socket binds, then the escalated npm test run passed. No plan deviations.
